column1: # The dog and cat evaluation set behind the pet-detector comparison (docs/pets.md): 216 photos from Wikimedia Commons, every file marked
# Public domain or CC0 on its Commons page (the licence column is the Commons licence category it was found under). The originals are pinned by
# sha256 (they are the uploaded files, not thumbnails). Fetched by scripts/fetch-pets-eval-set.sh, which looks each pageid up on the
# Commons API for the file's URL; the page ids carry no titles, so no name is in the repository. How it was chosen, and labelled by eye on
# label: dog | cat | both (a dog and a cat) | none. group: dog, cat, both; art (a statue, painting, drawing or print of an animal: not a
# pet), wild (a big cat, a coyote: not a pet), toy (a stuffed animal), animal (another animal; the note says which), people (people

# only), scene (everything else). note: small (the animal is small in the picture), partial (hidden or cut by the frame), what animal, or - for none (a tab never stands alone in an empty field: the fetch script reads the columns with the shell).
